For large holders, self-custody is the core of asset security.

An exchange may compensate you once, twice, or even many times.

But the moment there is a single hack that causes losses exceeding what the platform can cover, it becomes a sea of corpses and blood.

So what truly matters is never “how much the exchange promises to pay,” but rather not exposing all assets to a single point of failure.

Large assets should be distributed across multiple cold wallets; for day-to-day use, reconfigure only a small amount of hot wallets. The exchange should hold only the necessary trading funds.

Store in layers: cold wallets, hot wallets, and exchanges.

An exchange’s advantage is convenience, but its drawback is concentration.

The more massive assets are concentrated, the more easily they become an attack target.

What big holders should manage isn’t just return rates, but their own probability of survival.

📰 Stablecoin sector doubles down again? Why did HIFI take $37M but not disclose its valuation?

HIFI, a company working on stablecoin payments and tokenized markets, has just completed a $37M Series A round. Notably, this is their first publicly disclosed fundraising round, but they don’t say how much it’s worth. CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph that the funding will be used to expand the business—especially to develop stablecoin payment and tokenization market offerings. At first glance, this looks more like an industry signal—when regulation and liquidity are both unclear, someone is willing to publicly burn cash like this.

Why is this news important?
This round suggests that stablecoin and tokenized payments are not niche plays, but are genuinely moving toward the mainstream. They didn’t disclose the valuation—instead, they emphasized that this is their first “priced” financing—which may indicate they want to operate more in a standardized way, but it could also mean the market isn’t yet willing to assign a high valuation to this model. There are several possible reasons behind this: first, stablecoins are infrastructure in the Crypto world, and regulators actually don’t want them to become purely financial tools; second, institutional investors’ acceptance of stablecoins is not low, but they worry about crashes or regulatory action; third, tokenized payments are a key breakthrough for Crypto to enter the traditional financial sphere.

Impact on the market
For BTC/ETH, this isn’t a direct catalyst. HIFI’s business model is more about combining payments with DeFi rather than making crypto itself. But it does mean the stablecoin ecosystem will continue to expand, which is a direction worth looking at long term. In the short term, it may not lead to an immediate effect on prices, but at least it shows that there is still “fresh capital” flowing into the sector. Historically, every time new money moves into the stablecoin space, it tends to drive upgrades to underlying infrastructure—such as faster settlement and lower premiums.

💡 I think this news is a neutral-to-positive signal for the stablecoin sector. It suggests the industry is continuing to explore, but in the short term it likely won’t bring explosive upside for BTC/ETH. If, in the future, regulation suddenly tightens, or if systemic risk emerges in the stablecoin market, then this logic won’t hold.

📰 稳定币赛道又加码？为什么HIFI拿$37M却没透露估值？

HIFI这家搞稳定币支付和代币化市场的公司刚完成了$37M的A轮融资。值得注意的是，这是他们首次公开要钱的轮次，但具体值多少钱他们自己都不说。CEO Zach Walsh对CoinTelegraph表示，这笔钱将用于扩大业务，尤其要搞稳定币支付和代币化市场的拓展。目前来看，这更像是一个行业信号——在监管和资金面都扑朔迷离的时候，有人敢这么公开烧钱。

为什么这条新闻重要？
HIFI这次融资说明稳定币和代币化支付不是什么小众玩法，而是真的要往主流走。他们没透露估值，反而强调这是首次“定价”融资，可能说明他们想更规范地做事，但可能也说明市场对这种模式还不太敢给高估值。这背后有几个原因：第一，稳定币是Crypto世界的基础设施，监管机构其实不希望它变成纯粹的金融工具；第二，机构投资者对稳定币的接受度其实不低，但就是怕它崩盘或者被监管；第三，代币化支付是Crypto试图进入传统领域的关键突破口。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH来说，这不算直接的刺激。HIFI的业务模式更多是支付和DeFi结合，不直接做加密货币本身。但意味着稳定币的生态在继续扩张，这是长期看好的方向。短期内可能不会对价格有立竿见影的效果，但至少证明这个行业还有活水。历史上看，每次有新钱进入稳定币赛道，都会推动一些基础设施的升级，比如更快的结算速度、更低的溢价等。

💡 我觉得这个新闻对稳定币赛道是个中性偏多的信号。这意味着行业在继续探索，但短期内可能不会给BTC/ETH带来爆发式利好。如果未来监管突然收紧，或者稳定币市场出现系统性风险，这个逻辑就不成立了。

title: 🛡️ La Regla del 1%: Cómo gestionar el apalancamiento en tu Futures Grid sin riesgo de liquidación
subTitle:
El atractivo del Futures Grid radica en la capacidad de amplificar los retornos de las oscilaciones del mercado mediante el uso de apalancamiento. Sin embargo, utilizar un apalancamiento excesivo (como 20x o 50x) sin calcular la distancia al precio de liquidación reduce drásticamente el margen de error, convirtiendo una corrección normal en la pérdida total del colateral.

Aplicar la Regla del 1% en la gestión de capital te permite aprovechar la eficiencia del margen sin exponer tu portafolio a riesgos catastróficos.

1. ¿En qué consiste la Regla del 1% en Bots Quantitative?

Riesgo Máximo Definido: Nunca arriesgues más del 1% al 2% de tu capital total disponible en una sola estrategia de Futures Grid.

Margen de Seguridad: Si tu cuenta cuenta con $10,000 USDT, el margen asignado al bot y su nivel de Stop Loss deben garantizar que, en el peor escenario (ruptura del rango), la pérdida máxima no supere los $100 - $200 USDT.

2. Apalancamiento Eficiente vs. Apalancamiento Especulativo

Apalancamiento Bajo (2x - 5x): Amplía la capacidad de mantener un rango de grilla extenso (márgenes de liquidación muy alejados del precio actual) y permite absorber mechazos violentos del mercado.

Apalancamiento Alto (>10x): Estrecha drásticamente la distancia entre el límite inferior/superior de la grilla y el precio de liquidación, haciendo que un movimiento repentino de volatilidad invalide la estrategia antes de completar ciclos de ganancias.

3. Consejo Táctico Express (Cálculo del Margen de Aislamiento)

💡 El "Tip" de Gestión de Riesgo: Al configurar tu Futures Grid en Binance, selecciona siempre el modo de margen Aislado (Isolated) en lugar de Cruzado (Cross). Ajusta el apalancamiento entre 2x y 3x como máximo y verifica en la pantalla de previsualización que la distancia al precio de liquidación esté por fuera de los niveles clave de soporte/resistencia semanales.

👉 ¿Qué nivel de apalancamiento sueles utilizar en tus bots de futuros? ¡Déjame tu opinión en los comentarios!

Si este análisis sobre gestión cuantitativa de riesgo te ayuda a proteger tu capital en Binance, sígueme para continuar descubriendo más estrategias automatizadas.

XRP Spot ETF Sees Net Inflow of $14.8852 Million in a Single Day; Two Leading Products Drive Most of the Increase

According to Odaily Planet Daily’s report of SoSoValue statistics, as of 9:24 p.m. U.S. Eastern time on September 24, the U.S. XRP spot ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $14.8852 million for the day. The figure is aggregated by a third-party market data and fund-flow statistics platform. This article could not directly verify the original creation/redemption notices from each issuer; therefore, it should be regarded as a media-transmitted statistical result rather than the regulator’s final disclosure.

In terms of structure, the net inflow on the day was contributed almost entirely by two products. Bitwise XRP ETF (code XRP) recorded a net inflow of $9.9051 million, accounting for roughly two-thirds of the day’s total net inflow. Its historical cumulative net inflow rose to $659 million. Franklin XRP ETF (code XRPZ) recorded a net inflow of $4.9801 million, bringing its historical cumulative net inflow to $497 million. Combined, the two products’ net inflow for the day totaled approximately $14.8852 million, closely matching the overall figure. This suggests that other comparable products in the same statistical scope did not generate a notable net inflow, or that creations and redemptions were broadly balanced on the day. As of the time of writing, the total net asset value of the XRP spot ETFs stood at $1.700 billion, the XRP net asset ratio was 1.77%, and historical cumulative net inflows totaled $1.763 billion.

Placing the three sets of numbers together yields two factual clues. First, the cumulative net inflow of $1.763 billion is slightly higher than the total net asset value of $1.700 billion. The difference may come from factors such as net value fluctuations, fees, reporting timestamps, and scope differences; the evidence itself does not provide itemized attribution, so the specific cause cannot be determined from this alone. Second, the net new capital added on the day accounted for about 0.84% of the cumulative net inflow. This is a moderate single-day increase—insufficient on its own to rewrite the medium-term capital trend—yet it shows that additional subscriptions continued even on top of the existing scale.

Regarding the transmission path to the crypto market, it is preferable to distinguish observable facts from the meaning implied by extrapolation. Observable is that when an ETF channel experiences net subscriptions, it typically means corresponding shares are created. Issuers or the market-making system must manage underlying asset exposure within a compliant framework. This mechanism links secondary-market demand with spot custody and over-the-counter liquidity. What requires caution is that a single day’s net inflow is not equivalent to a guaranteed rise in spot prices, nor does it mean that all subscriptions will immediately convert into publicly executed market buys on the same trading day. A 1.77% net asset ratio only indicates that the ETF group’s scale remains limited relative to XRP’s overall market value. Its marginal impact is more reflected in sentiment and institutional allocation signals rather than being a short-term pricing determinant.

In terms of editorial assessment, the value of this quick update lies in direction rather than magnitude. It confirms that U.S. compliant channels’ demand for XRP exposure is still ongoing, and that capital is concentrated in the two products from Bitwise and Franklin, with a clear “top-heavy” effect. However, a net inflow at the level of tens of millions of dollars relative to a $1.7 billion existing stock is not aggressive. Whether it forms a trend needs to be verified together with the continuity of net inflows over the following weeks, changes in discount/premium, and changes in shares. Until further disclosure of the original creation/redemption details, it is not advisable to interpret single-day data as sufficient evidence of a large-scale institutional entry.

XRP现货ETF单日净流入1488.52万美元 两只头部产品贡献主要增量

据Odaily星球日报转述SoSoValue统计，美东时间9月24日，美国XRP现货ETF录得单日总净流入1488.52万美元。该数字由第三方行情与资金流统计平台汇总，本文未能直接查验各发行商原始申赎公告，应将其视为经媒体转述的统计结果，而非监管口径的最终披露。

从结构看，当日净流入几乎由两只产品贡献。Bitwise XRP ETF，代码XRP，单日净流入990.51万美元，占全日净流入约三分之二，其历史总净流入升至6.59亿美元；Franklin XRP ETF，代码XRPZ，单日净流入498.01万美元，历史总净流入为4.97亿美元。两只产品单日合计约1488.52万美元，与总量基本一致，说明当日其余同类产品在统计口径内未形成可观净流入，或申购赎回大体平衡。截至发稿时，XRP现货ETF总资产净值为17.00亿美元，XRP净资产比率1.77%，历史累计净流入17.63亿美元。

把三组数字放在一起，可拆出两条事实线索。其一，累计净流入17.63亿美元略高于总资产净值17.00亿美元，差额可能来自净值波动、费用、统计时点和口径差异等因素，证据本身未给出逐项归因，不能据此断定具体原因。其二，当日新增资金约占累计净流入的0.84%，属于温和单日增量，尚不足以单独改写中期资金趋势，但显示在已有规模基础上仍有新增申购。

对加密市场的影响路径，宜区分可观察事实与外推含义。可观察的是：ETF通道出现净申购，通常意味着相应份额被创造，发行方或做市体系需要在合规框架内管理底层资产敞口，这一机制会把二级市场需求与现货托管、场外流动性连接起来。需要谨慎的是：单日净流入并不等同于现货价格必然上行，也不代表所有申购都会在同一交易日立即转化为公开市场的买入；净资产比率1.77%仅说明该ETF群体规模相对XRP整体市值的占比仍有限，其边际影响更多体现在情绪和机构配置信号层面，而非短期定价的决定变量。

编辑判断上，这条快讯的价值在于方向而非强度。它确认了美国合规通道对XRP敞口的需求仍在延续，且资金集中在Bitwise与Franklin两家产品，头部效应明显；但单日千万美元级别相对17亿美元存量规模并不激进，是否形成趋势，需要结合后续数周净流入连续性、折溢价与份额变化共同验证。在原始申赎明细进一步披露前，不宜把单日数据解读为机构大规模进场的充分证据。

📰 Bitget Steals $35.16 Million, but Why Didn’t BTC $121.25K Hit a Limit Down? And Why Hasn’t Regulation Looked On Indifferently?

Bitget admits it suffered a hot-wallet hacker attack worth $35.16 million, but insists that the private keys were not compromised. The exchange says users’ funds are covered by a protection fund. For users, it’s said to have no immediate impact, but the broader crypto industry now has another security incident to add to the record.

Why is this news important?
This attack draws attention because the hackers could access hot wallets but did not steal private keys. That suggests attackers may have leveraged API permissions or vulnerabilities in internal operations, rather than traditional private-key theft. It also exposes how even with insurance, centralized exchanges can still suffer major losses due to operational mistakes or API misuse. In essence, the internal risk controls failed—not a breakthrough in hacker technique.

In the industry cycle, this occurred during the bull market pullback phase. Compared with catastrophic events in 2023 like Solana and FTX, the scale is relatively manageable. Still, every security incident intensifies users’ trust crisis in centralized exchanges. And since the industry is currently in a phase of tightening regulation, this is undeniably adding insult to injury.

Why hasn’t regulation taken notice?
Because Bitget quickly acknowledged the issue and activated its protection fund, demonstrating a willingness to resolve the problem. Mishandling could trigger even harsher regulatory actions—this is currently the “golden 72 hours” for crisis public relations.

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC/ETH prices is limited. Right now, BTC $121.25K / ETH $2.7K is still in a bull market structure, and a security incident involving a non-main coin is unlikely to break the overall trend. But what does that mean? It means the market’s tolerance for security incidents at major exchanges is declining. If a similar event happens again in the future, it could spark broader risk-aversion sentiment.

From the big picture, the incident highlights the relative advantages of decentralized exchanges (DEXs). Users may accelerate fund transfers. In terms of the regulatory environment, requirements will likely shift further toward demanding greater transparency and higher security standards from exchanges. On the flow side, funds may move toward so-called safer top exchanges such as Binance and OKX.

Historically, the 2016 collapse of Mt. Gox caused a major drop in the crypto market, but the scale and impact mechanism of this incident are completely different. Its reference value is limited, but the lesson is similar: centralized risk will always exist.

Trading/analysis approach
💡 The support for BTC $121.25K hasn’t been broken, but this incident suggests that bull-market pullbacks could be more intense than people expect. If Bitcoin breaks below $80K, this view is invalid—meaning more room to the downside could open up.

以太坊市场全景解读：突破两千七百美元，ETF持续加持

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十五日，以太坊现货价格报二千七百一十一美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之二点一，表现优于大盘。价格从二千六百七十美元区域起步，连续突破多个整数关口，最高触及二千七百一十九美元，展现出强劲的上涨动能。小时级别K线显示，最近五根蜡烛中有四根收阳，且实体逐步放大，表明买方力量正在加速释放。

成交量方面，价格上涨过程中的单小时成交额达到四千三百万美元，较前一小时大幅放量，量价齐升的格局十分健康。从均线系统来看，七周期均线约二千六百八十八美元，二十五周期均线约二千六百八十美元，价格已站稳短期均线上方。但九十九周期均线仍在二千七百一十五美元附近，构成当前的关键阻力位，能否有效突破将决定后续走势方向。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标显示短线已进入超买区域，六周期RSI高达七十九点九五，十二周期为六十六点四九，二十四周期为五十六点八四。短期RSI的急速攀升意味着价格上行速度较快，存在技术性回调的可能，但中长期RSI仍处于合理区间，上涨趋势的基础并未动摇。

MACD指标表现亮眼，柱状图从负值区域强势翻正至三点五零，DIFF线快速上穿DEA线，形成标准的金叉形态。动能由弱转强的信号十分明确，为后续上涨提供了技术支撑。KDJ指标中，K值升至六十五点一一，D值为四十九点九零，J值达到九十五点五三，三线呈现多头排列，短期动能充沛。

布林带上轨位于二千七百零七美元，价格已突破上线，进入超买区域。这种突破布林带上轨的走势通常意味着强势行情，但也需要警惕回调风险。抛物线SAR指标位于二千六百五十八美元，远低于当前价格，提供了较好的下方支撑参考。威廉指标WR从负六十五快速攀升至负七点七四，同样确认了短期的强势格局。OBV能量潮持续走高至五十一万五千八百九十九，资金流入趋势明确。

三、市场情绪分析

从量化因子统计来看，以太坊的十五个因子中有四个发出做多信号，十个发出做空信号，一个保持中性，空头因子占比较高。综合指标偏向空头，但做多的胜率为百分之八十八点八九，高于空头的百分之七十点五三，说明多头信号一旦触发，其成功率反而更高。这种因子分歧较大的局面，通常出现在趋势转折的关键节点。

消息面上，以太坊ETF连续五天录得净流入，九月二十四日单日流入六千六百万美元，机构配置需求稳步增长。交易所储备比例降至历史新低的百分之三点四九，流通供应持续减少，供需格局对价格形成有力支撑。此外，一家大型资产管理公司在以太坊网络上推出了代币化风投基金，进一步丰富了链上生态。

然而，风险因素同样不容忽视。美国十年期国债收益率持续走高，市场对美联储加息的预期升温，宏观压力可能抑制风险资产的表现。近期发生的交易所安全事件也提醒投资者注意资产保管风险。短线RSI进入超买区域，技术回调的概率在上升。

综合来看，以太坊短期走势强劲，ETF资金流入和供应收缩构成中期利好，但宏观利率压力和超买信号需要警惕。建议关注二千七百一十五美元的九十九均线突破情况，以及后续ETF流入能否持续。

I read an old saying and suddenly it matched the chart of today.

In Graham’s “The Intelligent Investor,” there’s a lesson: 
Graham compares the market to a manic-depressive (bipolar) patient—every day it quotes you a price. When it’s excited, it gives you an outrageous price; when it’s depressed, it dumps things cheaply. Your job is not to catch his illness, but to use his emotions. In the crypto market, “the market’s man” has episodes several times a day.

Take today’s $ETH  as an example: right now it’s 2,713, and the 24h change is +2.82%. This kind of market action perfectly confirms the principle above. It’s not a coincidence—it’s the repetition of human nature reflected in the chart.

The more I think about it, the more I feel that in trading, at the end, what matters isn’t technique—it’s temperament.
Write it down; look back later to compare.

#ETH #投资哲学 #交易心态 #crypto

📰 Mine power shortage? Why does the UK’s AI compute capacity only roll out in the 2030s?

The UK Nscale supercomputer project has been delayed to the 2030s due to insufficient power grid capacity. This is not a small issue—it will directly slow the UK’s progress in developing its AI industry, and it also exposes a weakness in global infrastructure amid the compute race.

Why is this news important?
Power is the lifeblood of supercomputers. The Nscale project was originally meant to address AI compute shortages, but it has now become a victim of a “power shortage.” The root cause is that the UK’s power system is aging and cannot support highly energy-intensive equipment like AI data centers. This reveals two deeper logics: first, AI is not a sci-fi concept like “building an atomic bomb”—it really does require massive amounts of electricity and physical infrastructure support; second, in the global compute arms race, grid capacity cannot be solved with money alone—it requires a redesign of the entire energy system. This means that in the coming years, regions that can solve energy issues will truly gain an edge on the AI compute track.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this may boost demand for green energy solutions such as solar power and energy storage technologies. But the deeper impact is to accelerate the regionalization of the global compute market. Bitcoin and Ethereum may not be directly affected, but in the long run, if a country cannot support compute demand due to lagging infrastructure, it could indirectly weaken the adoption rate of its digital currencies. Historically, the oil crisis in the 1970s hindered the development of Japan’s electronics industry—perhaps the AI compute map will replicate a similar “infrastructure poverty” trap.

Trading/operation ideas
💡 I tend to believe this event will catalyze demand for sustainable compute, but it will likely have limited short-term impact on crypto prices. If, in the future, cases emerge where grid upgrades fail—such as a supercomputer center being forced to shut down due to a power outage—then BTC and ETH could rise due to risk-aversion sentiment. If new infrastructure solutions emerge, such as the U.S. using ultra-high-voltage power transmission to support data center construction, that would instead be positive for digital assets. This view is invalid if the UK government does not add investment to build nuclear power plants or an intelligent power grid.

📰 矿场电荒？为什么英国AI算力要等到2030年代才落地

英国Nscale的超级计算机项目因为电力电网容量不足，宣布延期到2030年代才能完工。这不是小事，直接拖慢了英国发展AI产业的步伐，也暴露了全球基建在算力竞赛中的短板。

为什么这条新闻重要？
电力是超级计算机的命脉，英国Nscale项目本计划解决AI算力短缺问题，现在却成了"电荒"的牺牲品。根本原因是英国电力系统老化，无法支撑AI中心这种高能耗设备。这揭示了两个深层逻辑：第一，AI不是"造原子弹"的科幻概念，它真的需要天量的电力和物理基建支持；第二，全球算力军备竞赛中，电网容量不是用钱就能解决的，它需要重新规划整个能源体系。这意味着未来几年，能解决能源问题的地区，才能在AI算力赛道上真正占优。

对市场的影响
短期看，这会提振对绿色能源解决方案的需求，比如太阳能、储能技术等。但更深远的影响是加速全球算力市场的区域化。比特币和以太坊虽然直接受影响不大，但长期看，如果某个国家因基建落后无法支撑算力需求，可能会间接削弱其数字货币采用率。历史上看，1970年代石油危机导致日本电子产业发展受阻，也许AI算力版图会复制类似的"基建贫困"陷阱。

操作思路
💡 我倾向于认为，这事件会催化对可持续算力的需求，但短期内对加密货币价格提振有限。如果未来出现电网升级失败的案例，比如某个超级计算中心因停电被迫停机，那么BTC和ETH可能会因避险情绪而上涨。如果出现类似美国用特高压输电支持数据中心建设的新基建方案，反而会利好数字资产。这个判断如果英国政府不追加投资建设核电或智能电网，就作废。

📰 Why did KelpDAO explode before mentioning compensation before LayerZero? 

KelpDAO sued LayerZero, claiming that the bridge was hacked and that the former CEO also backed it. LayerZero’s CEO fired back, saying “there’s nothing wrong with that.” So why did this blow up? In plain terms, yet another DeFi bridge security issue is trending.

KelpDAO filed a lawsuit against LayerZero and its CEO, arguing that LayerZero knew about the vulnerabilities in their bridge and still recommended using it. LayerZero, meanwhile, said “that’s nonsense”—sure, you can argue who said what first, but the bridge was indeed hacked, and the $292M rsETH disappeared. This is a major blow to all DeFi bridges and middlemen like LayerZero.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?
It’s not that simple. LayerZero is a long-standing player in DeFi bridging, and people used to assume it was reliable. Now KelpDAO is essentially using it as a scapegoat—meaning the reputation of DeFi bridges as a whole has been blacklisted. The root cause is that DeFi is inherently fragile: nobody can detect vulnerabilities in smart contracts with 100% certainty. LayerZero now has to take the blame. Regulators will likely pay closer attention too—previously regulators came knocking, but now it’s DeFi turning on itself. It also echoes the Binance Bridge incident before: it’s an issue of unclear responsibility between intermediaries and users.

Market impact
In the short term, ETH sentiment will likely be affected, since LayerZero uses rsETH. However, ETH’s price is not particularly high—under $2.7K it’s already falling anxiously—and this event probably won’t pull ETH down by another $100. In the long run, for DeFi bridges to survive, they need to make security responsibility clear. LayerZero will likely have to pay to resolve this, or alternatively buy out KelpDAO. BTC won’t be impacted much, since BTC doesn’t really play in DeFi. But coins like BNB and SOL could see some sentiment spillover.

💡 This is bad news for DeFi bridges, but not enough to make ETH drop. If regulators start stepping in on a large scale regarding DeFi security, this judgment would be invalid. Simply put: DeFi seems to be getting stricter.

subTitle:
Сегодня рынок криптовалют проходит через одно из главных событий сентября.
На Deribit истекают опционы примерно на $15,9 млрд по Bitcoin и $2,1 млрд по Ethereum — почти $18 млрд совокупно. Экспирация происходит сегодня, 25 сентября, в 08:00 UTC.
Но самое интересное — не сама экспирация.
Самое интересное — что произойдёт после неё.
📊 BTC сейчас находится в ключевой зоне
Bitcoin удерживается примерно в районе $84–85K, после недавнего движения к $87K.
При этом структура опционов показывает перевес call-контрактов над put. По данным Deribit, put/call ratio находился примерно в районе 0,7, а значительная часть открытого интереса сосредоточена в call-страйках выше текущей цены.
Это означает, что после экспирации рынок может потерять часть текущего «магнита» и хеджирования.
И именно поэтому я бы сейчас смотрел не на вопрос:
«BTC пойдёт вверх или вниз?»
А на то какой уровень рынок заберёт первым.
🟢👍🏻 Сценарий 1 — BTC возвращает $85K
Если Bitcoin закрепляется выше $85K, следующая важная зона — $87K.
Пробой и закрепление выше $87K может открыть пространство для движения к:
➡️ $90K
$90K сейчас выглядит особенно важной психологической зоной сопротивления.
🔴 Сценарий 2 — BTC теряет $84K
Если после экспирации продавцы получают контроль и BTC уверенно уходит ниже $84K, внимание переключается на:
➡️ $82K
➡️ $80K
Зона около $80K становится особенно важной, поскольку более глубокое снижение способно ускорить ликвидации лонгов.
⚠️ Самая опасная зона — $84–85K
Здесь я бы не спешил открывать позицию только потому, что цена «куда-то пошла».
После такой крупной экспирации возможны резкие движения в обе стороны.
Сначала выбивают одну сторону → собирают ликвидность → затем показывают настоящее направление.
Поэтому сегодня особенно важно смотреть на объём, открытый интерес и реакцию BTC после 08:00 UTC, а не только на свечу.
🧠 А что с ETH и XRP?
ETH также участвует в сегодняшней крупной экспирации — около $2,1 млрд опционов.
XRP сейчас торгуется примерно в районе $1,53–1,55, после сильной волатильности последних дней.
Для XRP я бы особенно следил за:
$1.50 → $1.66
Удержание $1.50 после сегодняшней волатильности будет важным для структуры, а движение к $1.66 станет уже проверкой сопротивления.

📰 Why 99% of the XRP stolen in the Bitget hacker case can’t be frozen?

In the September 24 Bitget hacker case, the hackers stole 1.0297 million XRP (worth about $15.7 million), but 99% of it remains locked in five newly created wallets. Since the XRP Ledger does not have a mandatory freeze mechanism, these funds cannot be recovered for the time being. This means that no matter how much pressure regulators apply, this portion of funds could be lost forever.

Why is this news important?
The root cause is an architectural flaw in the XRP Ledger. Unlike stablecoins such as USDT, the XRP Ledger is a decentralized ledger without a centralized authority that can force transactions to be frozen. This exposes XRP’s shortcomings in security and regulatory compliance. Once the hackers exploit vulnerabilities to transfer assets to decentralized wallets, the recovery pathway is completely cut off. This is in stark contrast to the situation in 2023 after the Binance hack, when some USDT was frozen—highlighting the huge differences in regulatory arbitrage space among different blockchain assets.

What does this mean?
For the market, it will intensify investors’ concerns about the safety of decentralized assets. If hackers can easily steal XRP that can’t be recovered, other assets that use similar ledger structures (e.g., certain variants of DOGE and MATIC) may face comparable risks. More deeply, this directly challenges regulators’ trust in XRP. Recently, the U.S. SEC approved Ripple’s acquisition of Alaska, which was based on its finding that Ripple’s compliance framework is acceptable—but now that finding may face severe testing.

Market impact
In the short term, XRP will face pressure. Although the current XRP price has rebounded to $1.529.529, the aftermath of the hacker case may cause institutional investors to retreat further. With $84,001.68 worth of BTC and $2,671.8 worth of ETH both in a correction phase, capital may flow from more volatile XRP to safer assets. But the long-term impact depends on how regulators respond. If the U.S. SEC tightens XRP regulation as a result, it could push the entire token issuance ecosystem toward a more centralized model. Conversely, if the market believes this is an inherent cost of decentralization, XRP could potentially avert the crisis through technical upgrades (such as introducing a freeze mechanism).

For historical reference, look at the 2016 Mt. Gox incident. Back then, a smaller proportion of the stolen bitcoins was recovered, but bitcoin ultimately survived thanks to the consensus mechanism. The key difference is that XRP’s community governance is currently looser.

💡 I believe that in the short term, XRP will continue to face pressure, and the $1.529.529 price range will become a key support level. If next week the SEC issues an official statement expressing concern, the price could fall below $1.529.529. However, this view has a condition for invalidation—if the hackers continue transferring these funds to new decentralized wallets, regulators’ ability to hold them accountable will become more difficult, thereby supporting the price.

📰 为什么Bitget黑客案中99%被盗XRP无法冻结？

9月24日Bitget黑客案中，黑客盗取了102.97万枚XRP（价值约1570万美元），但其中99%仍被锁在五个新创建的钱包里。由于XRP Ledger没有强制冻结机制，这些资金暂时无法追回。这意味着无论监管机构如何施压，这部分资金都可能永远流失。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因是XRP Ledger的架构缺陷。与USDT等稳定币不同，XRP Ledger是去中心化的账本，没有中心化机构可以强制冻结交易。这暴露了XRP在安全性和监管合规性方面的短板。当黑客利用系统漏洞将资产转移至去中心化钱包后，追回路径就被彻底切断了。这与2023年Binance遭黑客攻击后部分USDT被冻结形成鲜明对比，凸显了不同区块链资产在监管套利空间上的巨大差异。

这意味着什么？对市场而言，这会加剧投资者对去中心化资产安全性的担忧。当黑客能轻易窃取无法追回的XRP时，其他采用类似账本结构的资产（如DOGE、MATIC的某些变种）也可能面临类似风险。更深层的是，这件事将直接冲击监管机构对XRP的信任。近期美国SEC批准Ripple收购Alaska，正是基于其合规框架的认定——但现在这个认定可能面临严峻考验。

对市场的影响
短期看，XRP会承压。当前XRP价格虽反弹至$1.529.529，但黑客案余波可能导致机构投资者进一步撤离。考虑到$84,001.68的BTC和$2,671.8的ETH都处于调整期，资金可能会从波动性较高的XRP流向避险资产。但长期影响取决于监管如何应对。如果美国SEC因此收紧XRP的监管，可能导致整个代币发行生态转向更中心化的模式；反之，如果市场认为这是去中心化必然成本，XRP可能通过技术升级（如引入冻结机制）来化解危机。

历史参考可以看2016年Mt. Gox事件。当时被盗比特币被追回的部分比例更低，但比特币最终凭借共识机制存活下来。关键区别在于XRP的社区治理目前更松散。

💡 我认为短期内XRP会继续承压，$1.529.529这个价格区间将成为关键支撑位。如果下周SEC对此事发表正式声明表示担忧，价格可能跌破$1.529.529。但这个判断有失效条件——如果黑客继续转移这些资金到新的去中心化钱包，监管的追责将变得更为困难，从而支撑价格。

Anzi’s plans over the past few years are a little bit magical.

The inscription meme was hot for a few months, near the top, and then they started a massive layout for inscriptions.

The Sol Meme was hot for a few months, near the top again, and then they started a massive layout for Meme.

When the Hype had just begun to gain momentum and people’s attention was still on the Meme, they started pushing hard to layout Meme again.

When Hype reached its peak, on-chain derivatives began to become the new consensus—so they started laying out on-chain derivatives too.

At the end of 2024, when I chatted with Anzi Wallet’s负责人, I had a strong feeling: with a company that big, with resources, capital, users—everything—why in Web3 does it always seem like they’re chasing market hot topics? It became an industry-typical doom-light.

At the end of 2024, he and I chatted in a small group. When I talked to him about on-chain derivatives, RWA, and prediction markets, I felt like that person was just kind of blank—like whatever I talked about didn’t feel connected to him at all. Later, all these industries rose one by one. I guess in his mind he kept a million-dollar dream tucked away, but forgot that he was in a financial infrastructure industry.

A company without any industry sensitivity naturally loses competitiveness.

Even though later they may have waited until others rose, and then tried to develop aggressively—that was totally useless and only burned goodwill.

At the end of 2024, when we talked about RWA, prediction markets, and on-chain derivatives, they started laying out heavily right then. Even if they lost, at least they started from the starting line.

Every time they wait for others to grow up first, then do their own layout—it’s pure loss of goodwill. Money spent doesn’t get a good return.

【You think this is a bargain-buy signal? What I see is institutions laying a bigger trap】

In the winter of 2019, ETH fell from 340 to 130—cut in half, then cut in half again. Back then, outsiders all said, “ETH is over.” So what happened? Institutions quietly accumulated, and later it climbed to 4800. I was there for those days, watching the price grind lower little by little. Every day in the groups there was nonstop shouting and cursing—meanwhile, cheap chips sat in the institutions’ hands.

Now we’re back at this level again. With a 45% drawdown, what kind of mindset do institutions have? A Bitwise report puts it plainly—when institutions experienced a 50% drawdown, they didn’t exit; instead, they set “exit conditions.” In plain English: they believe this spot is worth holding onto, but they need a safety latch.

This logic is something I’m all too familiar with. Institutions aren’t here to catch the falling knife—they’re here to “secure the spot.” What they fear isn’t the drop; it’s missing out. If it really drops to where they want it, they feel at ease—at least they know where their costs are.

Today I saw a piece of news: ARK folks are stirring things up again. They teamed up with Securitize to launch a tokenized venture investment fund, and they’re also taking exposure to OpenAI and Anthropic. I’ve seen this play before—back in the 2017 ICO wave, they used “scarcity” to tell the story. Only this time, the storyteller is the “queen of wood,” and the packaging has been swapped for a compliant-looking costume.

Will it actually work out in the real world? Honestly, I don’t care whether it can get implemented. What I care about is: if they’re pushing this at this moment, who are they trying to get in front of?
Retail sees, “Even institutions have entered.” Institutions see, “Retail is starting to take notice.” That information gap always exists.

So what are your attitudes right now? Do you dare to take this one on? As for me—I’ve kept some dry powder. I’m itching too, but I won’t go ALL IN again. That lesson from 2017—I’ll remember it for the rest of my life.

#ETH #加密市场 #BP #盘感

content:
【你以为是抄底信号？我看见的是机构在布更大的局】

2019年的冬天，ETH从340跌到130，腰斩再腰斩。那时候圈外人都说"ETH完了"，结果呢？机构悄悄建仓，后来涨到4800。那段日子我就在，看着价格一点点磨，群里骂声一片，机构手上一把廉价筹码。

现在又到这位置了。45%的回撤，机构什么心态？Bitwise那份报告说得很直白——机构在50%回撤的时候，没跑，反而设了"退出条件"。翻译成人话就是：他们判断这位置值得留，但得有个保险栓。

这个逻辑我太熟了。机构不是来接盘的，是来"占坑"的。他们怕的不是跌，是踏空。真跌到位了，反而心里踏实——至少知道成本在哪儿。

今天看了条新闻，ARK那帮人又在搞事了，联手Securitize搞代币化风投基金，还搞了OpenAI和Anthropic的敞口。这招我见过，2017年ICO那波就是这么玩的，拿"稀缺性"讲故事。只不过这次讲故事的人换成了木头姐，包装换成了合规的外衣。

能落地吗？说真的，我不关心能不能落地。我关心的是：他们这个时候推这个，想让谁看见？散户看见"机构都进场了"，机构看见"散户开始关注了"。信息差这东西，永远存在。

你们现在什么心态？这波敢不敢？我自己嘛，留了底仓，手痒归手痒，但不会再ALL IN了。2017年那课，够我记一辈子。

#ETH #加密市场 #BP #盘感

title: Bitcoin ($BTC) Market Update 📊
subTitle:
Bitcoin remains one of the most closely watched assets in the entire crypto market — and for good reason. As the flagship cryptocurrency, BTC's price action often sets the tone for the broader market, influencing sentiment across altcoins, DeFi tokens, and even traditional risk assets. Whether you're a seasoned trader or just starting out, understanding what drives Bitcoin's movements is essential to navigating this space successfully. 🚀

## Why Price Action, Volume & Trend Matter 📈📉

Before entering any trade, it's critical to check three key factors:

- **Current Price Action** – Is BTC breaking key support/resistance levels, or is it consolidating in a range? Price action tells you the immediate story of buyer vs. seller control.
- **Trading Volume** – Volume confirms conviction. A breakout on low volume is often a trap, while a breakout on strong volume signals genuine momentum.
- **Overall Market Trend** – Are we in a bull market, bear market, or sideways chop? Trading with the trend, not against it, dramatically improves your odds of success.

Ignoring any one of these factors is like driving with your eyes half-closed — you might get lucky, but the risk isn't worth it. 🧭

## My Approach: Discipline Over Emotion 🧠

The biggest enemy of most traders isn't the market — it's their own psychology. Here's the mindset I stick to:

- ❌ **Don't FOMO** – Chasing green candles after a pump almost always means buying the top. Patience beats panic.
- ✅ **Wait for Confirmation** – Let the market show its hand before committing capital. A confirmed breakout or reversal pattern is far more reliable than a guess.
- 🛡️ **Manage Risk Carefully** – Position sizing, stop losses, and never risking more than you can afford to lose are non-negotiable rules, no matter how confident you feel.

Trading isn't about being right every time — it's about staying in the game long enough to let your edge play out. ⚖️

## What Do You Think About $BTC Today? 🤔

Every trader has a different read on the charts, and that's the beauty of this market — no single opinion is "correct" until price proves it. So where do you stand?

- 🔺 **Bullish** – You believe BTC is gearing up for another leg up.
- 🔻 **Bearish** – You see signs of weakness and expect further downside.
- ➡️ **Sideways** – You think BTC will continue consolidating before its next major move.

Drop your analysis in the comments below and let's discuss! 👇 The community's collective insight is often more valuable than any single analyst's take.

## Final Reminder ⚠️

This post is for **educational purposes only** and should not be taken as financial advice. Always do your own research (DYOR), consult reliable sources, and consider your personal risk tolerance before making any trading decisions. The crypto market is volatile, and capital preservation should always come first. 💡

On-chain monitoring says Bitget stolen assets are topped by XRP, ETH, and USDT

Regarding the latest narrative around abnormal asset transfers involving Bitget, current conclusions can only be based on secondary attributions: Odaily Planet Daily, citing Lookonchain monitoring, reports that in the detailed list of stolen assets, the top three by size are XRP, ETH, and USDT. XRP is about 102.93 million units, worth approximately $157.48 million; ETH is about 31,890 units, worth about $85.75 million; USDT is about 34.75 million units, worth about $34.75 million. The list also includes USDC at about 21.05 million units, USD₮0 at about 19.67 million, XAUt at about 3,000 units worth $12.82 million, BNB at about 12,719 units worth $9.88 million, AVAX at about 821,012 units worth $8.38 million, and TRX at about 20.59 million units worth about $7.07 million.

It is important to emphasize that these figures are estimates from on-chain monitoring institutions and have been relayed by the media. The evidence does not include Bitget’s official announcements, explanations of the attack path, or updates on freezing or fund recovery, and it cannot directly prove a final loss figure under any specific accounting standard.

The background of the incident is that once a centralized exchange is involved in large-scale abnormal movement across multiple assets, the market will first distinguish between “hot-wallet operational reallocation,” “security incidents,” and “on-chain label misclassification.” This material only provides an asset-composition snapshot, presenting a mixture of stablecoins, mainstream chain assets, and platform-related holdings. If the monitoring attribution holds, the affected liquidity is not limited to a single chain or a single trading pair.

At the core factual level, only three points can be confirmed: the attribution of the message is that Odaily relays Lookonchain; the listed top items are highly concentrated, with the XRP single-line estimate already exceeding $150 million; and the remaining assets are relatively scattered, ranging from several million to just over tens of millions of dollars. Beyond that, with insufficient information, no conclusion can be drawn about the attacker’s identity, the intrusion method, whether private keys or a permissions system were involved, or whether user assets are fully covered.

In terms of logical breakdown, the first question is the accounting scope: labeling an on-chain address as “stolen” does not necessarily equal the exchange’s final net loss. If later events include freezing, returns, insurance payouts, or internal reserves absorbing the impact, the transfer size visible to outsiders would differ from the true economic impact.

The second question is the structure: stablecoins and assets like ETH and BNB are easier to move across venues quickly, while XRP and TRX depend on their respective networks and the exchange’s deposit/withdrawal channels, making tracking and interception more difficult in different ways.

The third question is timing: in the absence of an official timeline, any claim that directly infers a systemic solvency crisis from the asset details crosses the boundary of available evidence.

The impact path on the crypto market is more likely to be reflected in sentiment and risk control, rather than instantly changing the fundamentals. In the short term, trading platforms will re-verify deposits/withdrawals, address labels, and abnormal alerts. Market makers may reduce exposure to related counterparty platforms, while on-chain analysts will continue tracking whether funds enter mixers, cross-chain bridges, or over-the-counter exchange channels. If stablecoins make up a high proportion, market attention will focus on the issuer’s freezing capability and legal cooperation. If the share of mainstream coins rises, attention will shift to whether selling pressure is concentrated in a small number of liquidity pools. What must be avoided is equating “monitoring-detected transfers” directly with “already sold off.”

Editor’s note: This is a security lead worth continuing to track, but the strength of current evidence only supports “on-chain monitoring details relayed by the media,” and does not support confirming the root cause of the incident, the responsible party, or the final shortfall. Readers should focus on three things going forward: whether Bitget releases verifiable official announcements; whether the relevant stablecoin and exchange addresses show signs of freezing or fund return; and whether law-enforcement and audit institutions provide an independent set of figures. Until official confirmation, all amounts should be treated as estimated ranges rather than definitive conclusions.

链上监测称Bitget被盗资产以XRP、ETH、USDT居前

围绕Bitget资产异常转移的最新叙事，目前只能建立在二手归因之上：Odaily星球日报转述Lookonchain监测称，相关被盗资产明细中，规模前三位为XRP、ETH与USDT，其中XRP约1.0293亿枚、折合约1.5748亿美元，ETH约31890枚、价值约8575万美元，USDT约3475万枚、约合3475万美元；其后还包括USDC约2105万枚、USD₮0约1967万枚、XAUt约3000枚折合1282万美元、BNB约12719枚价值988万美元、AVAX约821012枚价值838万美元，以及TRX约2059万枚约合707万美元。需要强调的是，这些数字来自链上监测机构的估算并经媒体转述，证据未包含Bitget官方公告、攻击路径说明、冻结或追回进展，也不能直接证明最终损失口径。
事件背景在于，中心化交易所一旦涉及大额多币种异动，市场会先区分“热钱包运营调拨”“安全事件”与“链上标签误判”。本材料给出的只是资产构成快照，且以稳定币、主流公链资产与平台相关资产混合呈现，说明若监测归属成立，受影响流动性并不局限于单一链或单一币对。核心事实层面可确认的仅有三点：消息归属为Odaily转述Lookonchain；列出的前几项资产集中度较高，XRP单项估算已超过1.5亿美元；其余币种金额相对分散，从数百万到三千余万美元不等。除此之外，攻击者身份、入侵方式、是否涉及私钥或权限系统、用户资产是否全额覆盖，均无足够信息下结论。
逻辑拆解上，第一问是口径：链上地址被标注为“被盗”并不必然等于交易所最终净损失，若后续发生冻结、返还、保险赔付或内部准备金吸收，外部看到的转移规模与真实经济影响会不同。第二问是结构：稳定币与ETH、BNB等资产更易快速跨场所流转，XRP与TRX则依赖各自网络与交易所充提通道，追踪和拦截难度并不相同。第三问是时间：在缺乏官方时间线时，任何把资产明细直接推断为系统性偿付危机的说法都越过了证据边界。
对加密市场的影响路径更可能体现在情绪与风控，而非立即改变基本面。短期看，交易平台会复核充提、地址标签与异常告警，做市商可能降低对相关平台对手方敞口，链上分析师会继续跟踪资金是否进入混币、跨链桥或场外兑换渠道。若稳定币占比较高，市场关注点会落在发行方冻结能力与司法协作；若主流币占比上升，则关注抛压是否集中到少数流动性池。需要避免的是把“监测到转移”直接等同为“已经抛售”。
编辑判断：这是一条值得持续跟踪的安全线索，但当前证据强度只支持“有媒体转述的链上监测明细”，不支持确认事故根因、责任主体或最终缺口。读者应把后续重点放在三件事：Bitget是否发布可核验公告，相关稳定币与交易所地址是否出现冻结或回流，执法与审计机构是否给出独立口径。在官方确认前，所有金额都应视为估算区间而非定论。

📰 Visa just said bank-level protection is enough—so why is Tether suddenly going on-chain to be transparent? Why is “stablecoin 2.0” tougher than regulatory requirements?

Just a couple of days ago, Visa said it would use bank-grade security standards to pave the way for stablecoins. Now Tether’s co-founder, Collins, has directly put forward the concept of “stablecoin 2.0”: publicly posting reserves on-chain. This means users can not only see what assets Tether has, but also obtain a portion of investment returns directly through code. For users who want to figure out where the money goes—and don’t want to be trapped—it’s a good thing. But for Tether, making things more transparent may force it to manage its reserves even more strictly.

Why is this news important?
This move by Tether isn’t just a response to regulatory requirements—it’s an active push. The biggest trust foundation for stablecoins today is the “black-box” reserves, but users can only get a total summary from Tether. With this on-chain transparency, it’s like spreading the ledgers open so users can see, in real time, specific assets such as cash, bonds, and real estate. This is standard practice for USD stablecoins, but for crypto stablecoins, it means users can distinguish them from traditional wealth-management products—crypto stablecoins’ return models can be more flexible. Why does that matter? Because what the crypto market fears most right now is a “sudden implosion,” and transparency can directly address that trust problem.

Market impact
The immediate impact on BTC and ETH should be limited, but in the long run it may lower the trust barrier across the entire crypto ecosystem. That means ordinary users may find it easier to accept on-chain stablecoins as a store of value, rather than only as a medium of exchange. This is especially beneficial for ETH, because many of ETH’s Layer 2 and DeFi ecosystems rely on on-chain stablecoins. A deeper impact is that if Tether truly can allocate returns according to a program, it could turn crypto stablecoins into something akin to “money market funds,” attracting more traditional capital. Historical reference: look at USDC and Circle’s compliance progress—but Tether is much bigger, so this move may be implemented faster.

Trading/Action idea
💡 This is an opportunity along the sentiment line, but pay attention to the support level at $2,700. If the price breaks below that level, it means the market’s acceptance of crypto stablecoins has declined—then this judgment is invalid. In short: Tether’s transparency is a plus for ETH, but the premise is that users are actually willing to move on-chain.

📰 Visa刚说银行级保护够用了，Tether现在突然要上链透明了？为什么稳定币2.0比监管要求更狠？

前两天刚说过Visa要用银行级安全标准给稳定币铺路，现在Tether的联合创始人Collins直接抛出稳定币2.0概念：直接把储备金上链公示。这意味着用户不仅能看到Tether有啥资产，还能通过代码直接拿到部分投资收益。这对想搞明白钱的去向，又不想被套牢的用户来说是好事，但对Tether来说，透明化可能逼着它更严格管理储备金。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Tether这步棋不只是响应监管要求，更是主动出击。目前稳定币最大的信任基石就是"黑箱"里的储备金，但用户只能看Tether报个总账。这次上链透明，相当于把账本摊开，让用户能实时看到现金、债券、房产这些具体资产。这对美元稳定币是常规操作，但对加密稳定币来说，意味着用户可以把它们和传统理财区分开——加密稳定币的收益模式可以更灵活。为什么重要？因为现在加密市场最怕的就是"突然暴雷"，而透明化能直接解决这个信任问题。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响应该有限，但长期看会降低整个加密生态的信任门槛。这意味着普通用户可能更容易接受链上稳定币作为价值存储工具，而不是只把它当交易媒介。这对ETH尤其利好，因为ETH的Layer2生态和DeFi很多都依赖链上稳定币。更深层影响在于，如果Tether真能做到按程序分配收益，可能会把加密稳定币变成类似"货币基金"的存在，吸引更多传统资金。历史参考可以看USDC和Circle的合规进展，但Tether体量更大，这次动作可能更快落地。

以太坊市场深度分析：机构需求强劲但短期面临抛压考验

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十五日晚间，以太坊报价二千六百九十一美元，过去五个小时线呈现逐步回落态势。价格从二千七百一十七美元开盘后震荡走低，最低触及二千六百六十九美元，随后在二千六百八十至二千七百美元区间内整理。当前价格位于七周期均线二千七百零二美元下方，但仍在二十五周期均线二千六百九十美元上方，短期均线出现走平迹象。九十九周期均线位于二千七百一十四美元，对价格形成上方压力。

布林带指标显示上轨位于二千七百一十七美元，中轨位于二千六百九十一点美元，下轨位于二千六百六十四美元。价格目前在中轨附近波动，带宽相对收窄，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键时刻。抛物线指标位于二千七百三十九美元，高于当前价格，发出短期看跌信号。但超级趋势线指标位于二千六百六十六美元，低于当前价格，仍维持看多信号，多空指标出现分歧。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标显示MACD线为三点三一，信号线为三点六五，柱状图为负零点三四。值得注意的是，MACD柱状图刚刚由正转负，这是短期动能转弱的明确信号。此前柱状图从四点六九逐步缩小至零点七三，最终翻负，说明多头力量正在衰竭。RSI六周期指标为三十六点七七，已进入偏低区域，十二周期指标为四十六点三七，二十四周期指标为四十八点二六，各周期RSI均位于中性偏弱区域。

Binance Secure: Protect Your Crypto Before You Trade

In the world of cryptocurrency, protecting your account is just as important as understanding the market. Whether you are trading Bitcoin, Ethereum, or other digital assets, a strong security setup can help reduce the risk of unauthorized access and scams.

1. Enable Two-Factor Authentication

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an additional layer of protection to your Binance account. Even if someone obtains your password, they may still need your second verification method to access the account.

2. Use a Strong and Unique Password

Never reuse your Binance password on other websites or applications. Create a long, unique password containing a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols.

3. Stay Alert Against Phishing

Crypto users are frequently targeted by fake websites, messages, emails, and social-media accounts. Always verify that you are using the official Binance platform before entering your login details.

Never share your password, verification codes, or other sensitive security information with anyone.

4. Protect Your Devices

Keep your phone, operating system, and Binance application updated. Avoid logging into your account on unknown or shared devices, especially when using public Wi-Fi.

5. Monitor Your Account Activity

Regularly review your login activity, withdrawals, and security settings. If you notice something unusual, take action immediately and secure your account.

6. Security Is a Daily Habit

Good crypto security is not a one-time setup. It is a habit. Strong passwords, 2FA, careful browsing, and awareness of scams can all contribute to better account protection.

Final Thought

Your crypto journey should begin with security. Trade responsibly, stay alert, and make account protection part of your daily routine.

Secure your account. Protect your assets. Trade with confidence.

This article is for educational purposes and is not financial advice.

📰 Why are crypto and Wall Street suddenly fighting?

Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges, and crypto firms into the same arena to fight over turf—from payments to stock ETFs. This isn’t exactly new, but there are more players lately, and competition has suddenly turned extremely intense. The biggest impact is likely on those dealing with payments and derivatives: banks want to get a foothold, and crypto companies also want to grab business—so both sides are on the battlefield.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that crypto assets have found a lever that can massively disrupt traditional finance—stablecoins and tokenized assets. In the past, banks had customer deposits and credit systems, while exchanges earned from trading fees. But now, stablecoins can bypass deposits, and tokenized assets can bypass parts of stock trading rules. At the heart of the competition is capital. These new tools allow capital to move faster and at lower cost, making it hard for traditional finance to stay uninvolved. Against the backdrop of tighter regulation, people suddenly realized that the shared “territory” is vast—from cross-border payments to disputes over ETF trading in the secondary market.

Impact on the market
This will structurally affect the landscape of the crypto market. The most direct transmission channel is that ETF capital may no longer focus only on Bitcoin ETFs, because stablecoins and tokenized assets can provide some ETF functions (for example, low-cost exposure to index constituents). For instance, South Korea is one of the most active crypto trading markets globally. If local capital shifts from crypto trading to stablecoins, it could directly create selling pressure on BTC. That means BTC price volatility could become more complex; you can’t simply interpret it as “ETF inflows = BTC rises.” The impact on ETH may lag somewhat, but in the long run, if traditional finance widely adopts tokenized assets, it could divert part of secondary-market trading volume.

💡 Put simply: If traditional finance embraces stablecoins and tokenized assets at scale, the main flow of capital in crypto may shift away from directly buying BTC/ETH toward platform tokens or related derivatives that provide these services. That would weaken the upward momentum for BTC and ETH, making more of the move depend on ETF flows and speculative sentiment. If regulators suddenly ban tokenized assets, this conclusion is invalid.

【Condition that invalidates the assessment】 If, suddenly, the U.S. Department of the Treasury issues guidance stating that tokenized assets must be led by traditional financial institutions, this assessment is invalid. What does that mean? The market will be reshuffled, and it will come down to who gets the license first.

📰 为什么加密和华尔街突然打起来了？

稳定币和代币化资产正把银行、交易所和加密公司赶到一起争地盘，从支付到股票ETF全玩。这可不是什么新事，但最近玩家多了，竞争突然白热化。影响最大的可能是那些做支付和衍生品的，银行想插手，加密公司也想抢生意，两边全是战场。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因是加密资产找到了能大规模冲击传统金融的抓手——稳定币和代币化资产。以前银行有客户存款和信用体系，交易所有交易手续费，但现在稳定币能绕过存款，代币化资产能绕过部分股票交易规则。竞争的核心是资金，这些新工具能让资金流动更快、成本更低，传统金融想不参与都难。在监管趋严的大背景下，大家突然发现原来共享的地盘这么多，从跨境支付到二级市场ETF都能撕逼。

对市场的影响
这对加密市场格局影响是结构性的。最直接的传导路径是ETF资金可能不再只盯着比特币ETF，因为稳定币和代币化资产能提供ETF的部分功能（比如低成本持有指数成分股）。比如韩国是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金如果从加密交易流向稳定币，就会直接导致BTC抛压。这意味着BTC价格波动可能更复杂，不能简单理解为"ETF流入=比特币涨"。对ETH的影响相对滞后，但长期看，如果传统金融大量采用代币化资产，会分流部分二级市场交易量。

💡 简单说：如果传统金融大规模拥抱稳定币和代币化资产，那加密市场的主要资金流向可能从直接买BTC/ETH，变成投资能提供这些服务的平台币或相关衍生品。这意味着BTC和ETH的上涨动力会减弱，更多依赖ETF资金和投机情绪。如果出现监管突然封杀代币化资产，这个判断作废。

1789 Capital拟募资30亿美元

据Odaily转述彭博社消息，特朗普长子Donald Trump Jr.旗下投资公司1789 Capital正寻求为第二支成长基金募资30亿美元，目前已从现有投资者处筹集约20亿美元。报道还称，1789 Capital目前管理资产规模已超过40亿美元，投资组合包括Anduril Industries Inc.、预测市场平台Polymarket，以及埃隆·马斯克旗下的多家公司，例如X、xAI和SpaceX。需要注意的是，上述信息来自媒体转述，材料未显示基金已完成募集，也未显示相关公司发布了直接公告。

核心变化在于，这只新基金若按目标推进，将进一步扩大1789 Capital的资本配置能力。报道同时提到，该机构计划减少投资项目数量、提高单笔投资规模，并主导更多融资轮。这意味着其策略可能从更分散的财务投资，转向更集中、更具影响力的轮次参与。对被投企业而言，大额资金不仅意味着估值和融资节奏的变化，也可能带来投资方在战略和治理层面的更高参与度。

与加密市场关系最直接的部分是Polymarket。材料显示，1789 Capital的投资组合已包括Polymarket；此前还有消息称，该机构正考虑领投Polymarket约10亿美元的新一轮融资，拟投资约3亿美元。但这里仍应区分事实与不确定性：已被报道的是“考虑领投”和“拟投资”，并非最终完成交易。预测市场平台处于加密应用、政治事件交易和信息聚合的交叉地带，机构资金进入通常会提升外界对商业模式、合规路径和用户增长的关注。

从影响路径看，若1789 Capital募资顺利，且继续加大对Polymarket这类项目的投入，市场可能会重新评估预测市场赛道的长期资金支持力度；相关项目在品牌背书、业务扩张和融资谈判中也可能获得更强议价能力。但短期内，这类消息对加密资产价格的影响并不直接，更多体现为一级市场资金偏好和叙事关注度的变化。

编辑观察：这则消息的重点不是某个代币的即时波动，而是政治资本、科技投资与加密应用之间的交汇正在加深。后续更值得跟踪的是基金实际募资进度、Polymarket融资是否落地，以及大额机构资金进入后，预测市场在合规和产品边界上的变化。

For the week of September 28–October 4, 2026, both Ethereum #Eth  and #BNB are showing positive short-term technical structures. However, ETH currently has stronger momentum and a more visible potential catalyst.
The overall setup points toward possible continued upside, although both assets face pullback risks. ETH needs to defend its recent breakout area, while BNB must overcome the important resistance around $800.

Ethereum: Strong Momentum, But Price Is Extended
#Ethereum  is trading near $2,714, gaining approximately 8.33% over the past seven days and 10.25% over 30 days.
The daily RSI-14 stands at 63.5, indicating solid buying momentum without reaching traditionally overbought territory. The MACD histogram remains positive at 10.15, while the 7-day SMA of $2,683.91 is above the 30-day SMA of $2,517.74. This combination points to an improving short- and medium-term trend.
On the upside, traders may focus on the $2,800 level first, followed by the $2,927.71 Fibonacci extension and eventually the psychological $3,000 zone. Reaching $3,000 would represent roughly a 10.5% increase from the current price.
Recent market coverage has also highlighted strong Ethereum ETF inflows, including approximately $210.4 million on September 22, adding to the institutional-demand narrative.

However, ETH's rapid advance also creates a pullback risk. Key support areas include the $2,673.22 daily pivot, the $2,699.46 Fibonacci 23.6% level, and the $2,633.86 38.2% retracement. A sustained decline below these levels could weaken the current breakout structure.
BNB: Positive Trend Meets Major Resistance
#BNB  is currently around $778.87, up roughly 4.41% over seven days and 11.09% over the past month.
Its daily RSI-14 is 62.5, while the MACD histogram remains positive at 1.52. The 7-day SMA of $775.17 is also above the 30-day SMA of $731.11, showing that the broader short-term trend remains constructive.
The major near-term hurdle is $800, which is only about 2.7% above the current price. If buyers successfully push through this level and establish support above it, attention could shift toward the $842.25 Fibonacci extension, followed by the broader $850–$900 region.
BNB's broader market narrative is also connected to activity across Binance and BNB Chain, including reported developments involving tokenized-stock activity on BNB Chain.

The key risk remains the $800–$806.53 resistance zone. A rejection from this area could send BNB back toward the $775 pivot/support region, followed by deeper levels around $756.35 and $740.85.
ETH vs BNB: Key Differences

ETH currently shows stronger momentum indicators and has a more direct institutional-flow catalyst. BNB, meanwhile, has delivered stronger 30-day gains but is approaching a significant resistance area around $800.

For ETH, maintaining the $2,673–$2,699 region would help preserve the current breakout structure.

For BNB, establishing a sustained move above $800 would be an important technical development.

Possible Market Scenarios

Bullish scenario:

ETH remains above approximately $2,673–$2,699 and moves toward $2,800, while BNB holds around $775 and successfully breaks through $800.

Pullback scenario:

ETH falls below the $2,673 pivot area, or BNB fails to break $800 and drops below $775. The next technical references would be around $2,633.86 for ETH and $756.35 for BNB.
Key Takeaway

Both ETH and BNB currently show constructive short-term structures, but they face different technical challenges. ETH's main focus is defending its breakout/support region, while BNB needs to overcome the $800 resistance barrier.

The setup would become weaker if ETH loses the $2,673–$2,699 support zone or if BNB fails around $800 and subsequently breaks below $775.

That’s why it’s important to know where to do DCA and where to close the DCA portion. Sometimes, even if the price reaches the DCA area, conditions don’t form and the trade is postponed. Once DCA happens and the loss decreases (price moves downward), the DCA portion is closed. The entry price is moved upward, and the loss is reduced. 二、价格走势分析

从小时K线数据来看，ETH在过去五个交易时段内呈现先横盘后下行的格局。开盘价从2713美元逐步下移至2695美元附近，最低触及2671美元后小幅反弹。成交量方面，第四个时段放量至23021个ETH，对应USDT交易额约6184万美元，显示下跌过程中有较为明显的抛售行为。最新时段成交量大幅萎缩至5914个ETH，表明短期抛压有所减轻。

从基本面来看，以太坊当前正处于多重利好与利空的交织之中。摩根大通的代币化基金资产管理规模已突破9.4亿美元，ARK Invest也推出了新的代币化风投基金，这些都验证了以太坊在传统金融整合中的主导地位。然而，交易所安全事件导致31890个ETH被盗并被兑换，给市场带来了一定的抛售隐忧。

三、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，7周期均线为2705美元，25周期均线为2689美元，99周期均线为2714美元。当前价格位于7周期均线下方但仍在25周期均线上方，短期均线呈现粘合状态，方向选择临近。指数移动均线中，7周期EMA为2697美元，与当前价格非常接近，说明短期处于关键支撑位附近。

RSI指标显示市场正在快速降温。6周期RSI从81以上的高位急剧回落至41.44，12周期RSI为49.11，24周期RSI为49.58，均已回到中性区域。前期RSI突破80进入严重超买区域后的回调属于正常的技术性修正，当前RSI回到50附近意味着多空力量重新趋于平衡。

四、市场情绪分析

[【ETH is actually a "backup" in the eyes of institutions?】

Let me say something that runs against common sense—you see the FNG Index at 71, ETH is up 5.6% over the week, and it looks like the market is pretty hyped. But in the Bitwise report I read, institutions on the BTC side are barely moving, while both ETH and SOL have set exit conditions.

So what does that mean?

It doesn’t mean institutions don’t have faith in ETH. It just means they’re not treating it as a core holding. BTC is belief—ETH is, at best, a transitional opportunity.

This isn’t just institutional snobbery; from a technical standpoint, the logic is pretty clear. On the daily chart, the level $ 2695 is where you have resistance above and support below—classic “trading in a vise” conditions. In the 4H structure, the higher highs and lower lows keep narrowing, while volume is gently increasing. That suggests both bulls and bears are building up energy, but neither side dares to make the first move.

So where’s the key? $ 2800 is the psychological line—if it breaks, near-term sentiment will accelerate. $ 2550 is the bottom boundary—if it breaks, the structure flips completely bearish. In reality, both sides are waiting for an external signal—something ETH itself can’t provide for itself.

Bringing it down to specifics—

📰 Just said wallet security was breached, and now the XRP incident escalates: why could a D'CENT attack siphon off $12.4M?

Two days ago, I just talked about iOS vulnerabilities threatening digital assets. Now, fresh developments have emerged in the D'CENT wallet hack case. According to CryptoBriefing, within 10 days, hackers used a vulnerability in the D'CENT app wallet to steal 12.4M XRP (worth about $197 million), affecting tens of thousands of users. What does this mean? Why could the attackers target XRP so precisely?

This time, the D'CENT breach wasn’t the first—but the scale is unprecedented. The hackers exploited flaws that the platform had not yet patched, bypassing KYC verification to steal funds directly from users’ wallets. Affected users are spread worldwide, with the average loss per person at about 32,000 XRP. This incident highlights the fragility of decentralized application wallets—especially exchange wallets like D'CENT that manage large amounts of XRP.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?
The root cause is a “security paradox” that is common in decentralized exchange wallets: to simplify the KYC process for user experience, it inadvertently gives hackers a direct attack path. The key issue in the D'CENT breach was that security patches weren’t updated in time, exposing operational vulnerabilities typical of institutional-grade wallets. This is similar to the recent Coinbase breach and points to systemic risks in regulatory gaps.

Impact on the market
In the short term, XRP faces price pressure because $197 million worth of it was actually stolen. The deeper impact is undermining investors’ confidence in DeFi wallet security. Historically, after similar incidents (such as the Bitfinex hack), XRP’s price has fallen on average by 15–20%. This means the entire DeFi industry will face stricter requirements for security audits, pushing the sector toward safer off-chain custody solutions.

Approach
This event has limited knock-on effects for BTC/ETH, but it will reinforce institutional investors’ preference for regulated, compliance-focused wallets. A key level to watch is XRP’s $1.592592 support—if it breaks, it would indicate panic sentiment spreading and would require rebuilding the industry’s broader view of wallet security across the entire crypto asset ecosystem. 前两天刚说过iOS漏洞威胁数字资产，现在D'CENT钱包被黑事件有了新进展。据CryptoBriefing报道，黑客在10天内通过D'CENT app钱包漏洞，盗走12.4M XRP（价值约1.97亿美元），波及上万名用户。这意味着什么？为什么攻击者能如此精准地瞄准XRP？

D'CENT这次被黑不是第一次，但规模前所未有。黑客利用平台未及时修复的漏洞，绕过KYC验证直接从用户钱包盗款。受影响用户遍布全球，平均每人损失约3.2万XRP。这次事件凸显了去中心化应用钱包的脆弱性，尤其是像D'CENT这样管理大量XRP的交易所钱包。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？
根本原因是去中心化交易所钱包普遍存在"安全悖论"：为了用户体验简化KYC流程，却给黑客提供直接攻击路径。D'CENT这次被黑的关键是未及时更新安全补丁，暴露出机构级钱包的运维漏洞。这和近期Coinbase被黑事件类似，都指向监管空白地带的系统性风险。

对市场的影响
短期看，XRP因实际被盗1.97亿美元导致价格承压。更深层影响是打击投资者对DeFi钱包安全的信心。历史上类似事件（如Bitfinex被盗）后，XRP价格平均下跌15-20%。这意味着整个DeFi行业将面临更严格的安全审计需求，推动行业走向更安全的链下托管方案。

操作思路
这次事件对BTC/ETH的连锁反应有限，但会强化机构投资者对监管合规钱包的偏好。值得关注的价位是XRP下方$1.592.592水平——如果跌破这里，说明恐慌情绪蔓延，整个加密资产业态的钱包安全观都要重塑。如果D'CENT开始大规模赔偿用户，这个判断作废。

ETH市场深度解析：超买回调后的方向抉择

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年九月二十五日，以太坊现货价格报二千七百零二美元，过去数小时经历了一轮冲高回落行情。ETH在亚盘时段曾触及二千七百四十三美元的日内高点，随后受宏观市场拖累回落至二千六百八十美元的日内低点，当前价格在二千七百美元整数关口附近震荡。

从驱动因素来看，以太坊近期获得了多重利好支撑。九月二十四日以太坊ETF单日净流入六千六百万美元，机构资金的持续配置为价格提供了上行动力。更值得关注的是，交易所ETH供应量已降至百分之三点四九的历史新低，供给端的显著收缩意味着市场上可流通的卖盘大幅减少，这一结构性变化对中长期价格形成有力支撑。此外，ARK投资在以太坊网络上推出了代币化风投基金，进一步拓展了以太坊在机构级应用场景中的版图。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日均线报二千七百零一点六七美元，二十五日均线报二千六百八十七点四九美元，短期均线位于中期均线上方，呈现多头排列格局。九十九日均线位于二千七百一十五点二六美元，略高于当前价格，构成短期上方阻力。

RSI指标经历了戏剧性的变化，六周期RSI从前几个小时的八十一点一七高位急剧回落至四十六点六五，显示超买状态已快速释放。十二周期RSI为五十一点九零，二十四周期RSI为五十点八四，三条RSI线回归中性区域，短期方向需要新的催化剂。MACD指标显示，MACD线为六点一九，信号线为三点零一，柱状图为三点一八，虽然仍维持多头格局，但柱状图较前值四点六九有所收窄，多头动能正在减弱。

KDJ指标中，K线降至五十五点七七，D线为五十七点四八，J线降至五十二点三六，三线从高位回落但尚未进入超卖区域。布林带显示，上轨为二千七百一十七点二三美元，中轨为二千六百九十点九二美元，下轨为二千六百六十四点六零美元，价格运行在中轨与上轨之间，仍有上行空间。ATR指标升至二十三点四零，波动率温和放大。

综合因子统计显示，十五个量化因子中有九个看多、五个看空、一个中性，多空比例为一点八比一，多头优势较BTC更为明显。但综合信号仍为短期看空，胜率约为百分之六十五点七九，提示短期回调风险尚未完全释放。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多空因素的激烈碰撞。利好方面，交易所供应量的历史性低位意味着持有者普遍看好中长期前景，惜售情绪浓厚。ETF持续净流入和ARK等顶级投资机构的入场进一步增强了市场信心。币安钱包新增USDT支付Gas费功能也降低了以太坊生态的使用门槛，有利于用户增长。

利空方面，期货市场上空头仓位创下五十一月以来新高，杠杆交易者正在押注价格均值回归。此外，Bitget黑客事件中部分被盗资金被转换为ETH，加上某巨鲸向交易所存入六千枚ETH，短期可能形成一定的抛压。美国十年期国债收益率飙升对ETH等风险资产同样构成压力。

短期来看，ETH的关键支撑位在二千六百六十五美元附近，即布林带下轨位置。上方阻力位在二千七百一十五美元至二千七百四十三美元区间。考虑到RSI已从超买区域回落至中性，若价格能在二千七百美元上方企稳，则有望开启新一轮上攻。建议投资者关注期货市场空头仓位变化及ETF资金流向，合理控制杠杆风险。

🏛️ 二、宏觀政策與監管焦點

title: 🚀 Bitcoin recupera fuerza, inicio de un nuevo impulso hacia los 90k
subTitle:
🚀 Bitcoin recupera fuerza: ¿estamos ante el inicio de un nuevo impulso?
El mercado de criptomonedas vuelve a mostrar señales interesantes después de varias semanas marcadas por alta volatilidad, presión macroeconómica y dudas regulatorias.
Durante los últimos días, $BTC  volvió a superar la zona de los $84,000–$86,000, llegando recientemente a máximos de aproximadamente ocho meses. El movimiento resulta especialmente llamativo porque ocurre después de un periodo en el que el mercado tuvo que absorber tasas de interés más altas y episodios de fuertes ventas. �
The Wall Street Journal +1
Pero el precio no es lo único que debemos observar.
🏦 El dinero institucional vuelve a Bitcoin
Uno de los datos más importantes actualmente está en los ETF Spot de Bitcoin en Estados Unidos.
Durante julio, los ETF habían llegado a acumular aproximadamente $5,800 millones en salidas netas durante 2026. Sin embargo, el escenario ha cambiado de manera considerable: esas pérdidas ya fueron recuperadas y los flujos acumulados del año han regresado a terreno positivo, alrededor de $800 millones. �
CoinDesk
Solo en los últimos tres días disponibles:
📅 22 de septiembre: +$714.7 millones
📅 23 de septiembre: +$346.9 millones
📅 24 de septiembre: +$190.7 millones
Esto representa aproximadamente $1,252 millones de entradas netas en tres jornadas consecutivas. �
Farside Investors
Esto importa porque muestra que el movimiento reciente de Bitcoin no depende únicamente de traders minoristas: nuevamente existe una entrada significativa de capital mediante productos institucionales.
🔷 Ethereum también está recibiendo capital
$ETH  tampoco se está quedando atrás.
Los ETF Spot de Ethereum registraron:
📅 21 septiembre: +$270.0 M
📅 22 septiembre: +$162.2 M
📅 23 septiembre: +$104.5 M
📅 24 septiembre: +$39.3 M
Eso suma aproximadamente $576 millones de entradas netas en cuatro sesiones. �
Farside Investors
Además, Ethereum consiguió recientemente superar una importante zona técnica alrededor de $2,661. Un análisis técnico publicado por Reuters identificó zonas cercanas a $2,775–$2,825 como área de consolidación y aproximadamente $3,050 como posible siguiente referencia técnica si el impulso continúa. �
Reuters
Por debajo, la zona cercana a $2,560–$2,565 merece vigilancia porque una pérdida sostenida de ese nivel debilitaría considerablemente la estructura reciente.
📈 ¿Qué está impulsando el mercado?
Actualmente parecen combinarse varios factores.
Primero, están regresando los flujos institucionales hacia los ETF.
Segundo, el mercado ha absorbido mejor de lo esperado algunos acontecimientos macroeconómicos que originalmente parecían negativos.
Tercero, durante las últimas sesiones hubo liquidaciones de posiciones bajistas, lo que también contribuyó a acelerar algunas subidas.
Y finalmente, ciertos avances regulatorios relacionados con activos digitales y tokenización han mejorado parcialmente el sentimiento del mercado, aunque todavía existe incertidumbre regulatoria. �
Barron's +1
⚠️ Pero todavía existen riesgos
A pesar de la recuperación, considero importante no interpretar automáticamente el movimiento como el inicio de un mercado alcista completamente confirmado.
Los rendimientos de los bonos estadounidenses continúan elevados y cualquier nueva subida importante podría presionar nuevamente los activos de riesgo.
También habrá que vigilar si continúan las entradas hacia los ETF. El actual movimiento de BTC tiene un respaldo institucional importante, pero una reversión de esos flujos cambiaría rápidamente el panorama.
Por eso, más que perseguir movimientos verticales, conviene observar si Bitcoin logra consolidar sus niveles actuales y construir soportes más altos.
🔎 Qué vigilar ahora
Para las próximas sesiones estaré observando principalmente:
$BTC: capacidad para mantenerse sobre la zona de $84K–$85K y volver a atacar los máximos recientes.
$ETH: comportamiento alrededor de $2,775–$2,825 y posibilidad de buscar posteriormente los $3,000–$3,050.
ETF Spot: si las entradas institucionales continúan después de varios días consecutivos positivos.
$SOL  y altcoins: si Bitcoin comienza a estabilizarse, una parte del capital podría rotar gradualmente hacia activos de mayor riesgo.
Bonos estadounidenses y dólar: siguen siendo dos variables macroeconómicas importantes para determinar cuánto apetito por riesgo puede mantener el mercado.
🧠 Mi lectura del mercado
El escenario de corto plazo ha mejorado notablemente.
Bitcoin está mostrando fortaleza, Ethereum presenta una estructura técnica interesante y, probablemente lo más importante, el dinero institucional está regresando.
Sin embargo, estamos entrando en una zona donde sería normal observar períodos de consolidación e incluso correcciones después del movimiento reciente.
Por ahora, mi enfoque sería:
🟢 Tendencia: recuperación / alcista de corto plazo
🟢 Flujos institucionales: positivos
🟡 Macroeconomía: todavía representa riesgo
🟡 Altcoins: selectivas; no todas acompañarán a BTC
🔴 Riesgo principal: subida brusca de rendimientos y reversión de los ETF
La gran pregunta para los próximos días será:
¿BTC logrará transformar el reciente rally en una tendencia sostenible o veremos nuevamente una corrección después del impulso institucional?
Yo estaré especialmente pendiente de los ETF y de la reacción del precio cerca de los máximos recientes.
¿Qué opinan ustedes? 👇
¿Bitcoin continuará hacia los $90K o creen que antes veremos una corrección?

📰 Why did the miners suddenly move? 4,500 BTC exchanged for 378 million yuan—yet only cost $1

A large Bitcoin wallet that had been holding for 4 and a half years (from August 2019 to now) suddenly moved all 4,499 BTC on Friday. It transferred roughly $378 million on-chain, but the transaction fee was only about $1.10. It’s like someone deposited a lifetime of savings into a bank account and only paid a 1-cent ticket. With such a huge commotion, you’d expect it to draw attention—but it didn’t.

Why is this news important?
This transaction is important because it exposes a peculiar phenomenon in the Bitcoin market: when large funds move on-chain, they can still find extremely low-cost routes. 4,500 BTC is worth nearly $3.8 billion today (calculated at $84,478.27 per BTC). Being able to complete a transfer at almost zero cost suggests that the Bitcoin Lightning Network or some undisclosed evasion mechanisms still exist. This may imply:
- Some participants have psychological expectations of today’s high-fee environment and prepared alternative solutions
- Or a certain protocol vulnerability or special tool is known by only a few
Such a large transaction should have stirred market sentiment—but in reality, the impact is almost zero. Instead, it hints that the market has grown numb to these kinds of “shady operations.” Why is this news important? It means that even at a macro level of capital flows, Bitcoin still has hidden channels, contradicting the mainstream assumption that “large transactions must trigger volatility.”

Impact on the market
No direct shock to BTC/ETH prices, but it implicitly signals increasing market segmentation. Big players can transfer at extremely low cost, while ordinary traders still face high fees, which may accelerate:
- A trend of funds moving to more private wallets or off-chain tools
- Greater acceptance among ordinary users of Layer 2 solutions like the Lightning Network
Has there been a similar case in the past? In 2017, an anonymous address transferred tens of millions of dollars worth of BTC in a very short time, which sparked speculation about “regulatory arbitrage.” Although the current event has no direct regulatory connection, it similarly reveals that some players can ignore existing transaction rules.

Trading/operational thinking
💡 This may suggest that a group of “invisible rich” participants in the Bitcoin ecosystem is still active, and they have low-cost transfer methods that ordinary users aren’t familiar with. For the market, this doesn’t indicate a short-term price direction. But it does mean that if regulation increases in the future or fees remain high, these hidden channels could become a preferred choice for some capital—making transparent on-chain transactions harder to attract attention. If next week sees a surge of many small transactions, this assessment will be invalid.

一个囤了4年半（2019年8月至今）的比特币大钱包周五突然把4499枚BTC全搬走，在链上转了大约3.78亿美元，手续费却只花了约1.10美元。这就像有人把毕生积蓄一次性存进银行，只付了张1分钱的票据，这么大的动静居然没引起什么注意。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条交易之所以重要，是因为它暴露了比特币市场一个奇特的现象：大资金在链上转移时，依然能找到极低成本的路径。4500枚BTC相当于当前价值近38亿美元（按$84,478.27/BTC计算），能在几乎零成本的情况下完成转移，说明比特币闪电网络或某些未公开的规避机制依然存在。这可能意味着：
- 部分玩家对当前高费用环境有心理预期，并准备了替代方案
- 或是某种协议漏洞或特殊工具被少数人掌握
这种大额交易本该搅动市场情绪，但实际影响几乎为零，反而暗示市场对这种“骚操作”已经麻木。为什么这条新闻重要？意味着比特币在宏观层级的资金流动中，依然存在隐秘的通道，这与主流认知中“大额交易必引发波动”的假设产生矛盾。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH价格没有直接冲击，但隐含着市场分层加剧的信号。大玩家能用极低成本转移，而普通交易者仍需面对高昂费用，这可能加速：
- 资金向更私密的钱包或链下工具迁移的趋势
- 普通用户对闪电网络等Layer2方案的接受度提升
历史上类似事件参考？2017年曾有匿名地址在极短时间内转移数千万美元BTC，当时引发了市场对“监管套利”的猜测。当前事件虽无直接监管关联，但同样揭示了部分玩家能无视现有交易规则。

操作思路
💡 这可能暗示比特币生态中“隐形富豪”群体仍在活跃，他们掌握着普通用户不熟悉的低成本转移手段。对于市场而言，这不代表短期价格方向，但意味着如果未来监管加强或费用持续高企，这些隐秘通道可能成为部分资金的首选，反而让链上透明交易更难获得关注。如果下周出现大量小额交易突然涌入，这个判断作废。

以太坊市场深度分析：供应紧缩遇宏观逆风，短期方向待选择

2026年9月25日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间9月25日晚间，以太坊现货报价2725美元，过去5个小时内价格在2687美元至2743美元区间运行。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及2743美元的短期高点后出现回落，最新一根K线收于2709美元，上影线较长，显示上方存在一定抛压。

均线系统方面，7周期均线报2698美元，25周期均线报2685美元，短期均线呈多头排列且向上发散，表明短期趋势偏多。然而99周期均线位于2715美元，当前价格刚刚站上长期均线，需要确认有效突破。布林带上轨报2716美元，中轨2689美元，下轨2663美元，价格在中轨上方运行，但已接近上轨区域。

以太坊现货ETF同样表现强劲，连续5个交易日录得净流入，9月24日单日净流入6600万美元。更为重要的是，交易所以太坊余额已降至总供应量的3.49%，创下历史新低，供应紧缩效应显著。这一结构性变化意味着市场上可流通的以太坊数量大幅减少，从供需关系角度对价格形成长期支撑。

二、技术指标解读

动量指标方面，RSI6报66.28，RSI12报61.29，RSI24报54.91，短期RSI从超买区域回落，此前RSI6曾触及81的超高水平。MACD指标表现积极，DIFF线报6.23，DEA线报2.09，柱状图4.15，MACD保持多头排列且柱状图持续扩大，显示中期动能仍然偏多。

KDJ指标中，K值61.79，D值57.09，J值71.19，三线处于中高位区域，J线有拐头向下迹象，提示短期可能面临调整压力。威廉指标报负44.58，处于中性偏弱区域。ATR指标报21.94美元，较前一小时20.75美元有所上升，波动性温和放大。

综合因子统计显示，15个量化因子中仅5个发出做多信号，10个发出做空信号，空方占据明显优势。复合指标给出短线偏空信号，胜率约72%，提示短期内下行风险不容忽视。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重利好与利空的交织。利好方面，除了ETF持续流入和交易所供应创历史新低外，ARK Invest在以太坊网络上推出了代币化风投基金，进一步提升了以太坊的机构应用价值。币安钱包新增USDT支付Gas费功能，降低了用户参与门槛，有利于生态扩展。

利空方面同样不容忽视：近期交易所黑客攻击事件中，攻击者持有约68000枚以太坊，价值约1.83亿美元，形成巨大的潜在抛压；某大户向交易所存入6000枚以太坊，价值约1610万美元，增加了短期卖盘；RSI此前触及81的超买水平后开始回落，技术面存在回调需求。

从宏观环境看，美国国债收益率飙升对包括以太坊在内的风险资产构成压力，但以太坊ETF的持续流入和供应紧缩的基本面改善为价格提供了有力支撑。建议投资者关注2685美元支撑位和2743美元阻力位的表现，短线操作为主，注意控制风险。

📰 Just said Ethena would diversify—now it’s directly going public: Why does DeFi keep getting more tightly tied to exchanges?

A couple of days ago, I just mentioned that Ethena would diversify its assets, and now it’s partnering with Binance to launch tokenized stocks. Put simply, it expands the USDe collateral from pure crypto assets to publicly traded company stocks. The goal is to stabilize USDe yield when the crypto world is surging wildly or crashing just as fast. This is helpful for stabilizing the DeFi market—but why partner specifically with Binance?

Why is this news important?
Ethena’s move is significant, as it signals that DeFi is making a major push into traditional finance. Over the past year, regulators have been saying crypto can’t stay detached from real-world finance. With Ethena teaming up with Binance for this, it’s like giving regulators a shot of confidence—look, DeFi is working to get better. Behind this is a shift in funding needs: people have realized that yield volatility in the crypto world is too high, so they need more stable products. And partnering with Binance isn’t random either—Binance has the most crypto users globally, and also strong derivatives coverage for listed-company stock products. It’s a “strengths complement strengths” combination.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this is sentiment-positive for BTC and ETH. BTC and ETH act as the market’s barometer—when a major player like Ethena embraces traditional finance, it can boost market confidence. In the long run, it suggests the crypto market is transitioning from a purely speculative arena to an asset allocation one. Historically, every financial innovation goes through this phase—for example, the internet did decades ago. Also, this move could encourage more stablecoins to diversify, helping avoid a future crisis like the one that caused Tether to nearly collapse after a sharp Bitcoin price crash.

Trading thesis
💡 Diversifying USDe is a trend, but in the short term, the effect on BTC and ETH prices is mostly a sentiment lift. I think over the next 1–2 weeks, if Ethena’s tokenized stock can run smoothly, ETH could find support above $2,700. If there are large-scale redemptions or regulators suddenly tighten rules, this view would be invalid. And if we see another “XRP-style” mania rally, then we’ll need to reassess.

How do you see this change? Do you think DeFi will always track Bitcoin’s price, or will it eventually stand on its own as a complete ecosystem?

📰 How Fast Is the New Sol Compiler Really? What Does Improved Ethereum Development Efficiency Mean?

Ethereum has just switched to a new Sol compiler, and the speed improvements are obvious—making it faster for developers to write code. This is good news for smart contract developers around the world, meaning that in the future, cooler applications can be built on Ethereum more quickly. Why the switch all of a sudden? The old compiler was bottlenecking things, and the new version is designed to solve that problem. The biggest impact is, of course, on the Ethereum ecosystem, but other chains that rely on Solidity could also be affected.

Why is this news important?
This is not a minor tweak—it’s an efficiency revolution. Think about it: before, compiling a complex contract could take half a day; now you get results in seconds. Behind it is the demand for long-term growth in the Ethereum ecosystem— the more complex smart contracts become, the more development tools must keep up, otherwise they’ll drag progress. It’s very similar to what happened when browsers evolved from IE6 to Chrome—being able to run more complex browser games is fundamentally why the shift mattered. Now that Ethereum smart contract applications (DeFi, NFTs, GameFi) are getting heavier, compiler speed is productivity.

Market impact
In the short term, sentiment toward ETH could get a boost, since the developer experience improves. But if you’re asking whether it can directly push ETH to $3K, that assumption is off the table. Looking longer term, better development tools can attract more developers to Ethereum, which theoretically benefits on-chain activity. But the bigger question is whether this will also benefit other chains (like Solana or Avalanche) that support Solidity ecosystems. If there’s competition over standardized cross-chain developer tools, then Ethereum’s advantage could weaken. Historically, early on during technological iterations, whoever runs first tends to gain the edge (for example, Ethereum’s early exclusive advantage in Web3.0). But this time, Solana’s compiler speed is also quite fast, leading to a “duopoly” showdown.

Trading/Action framework
This news is neutral to mildly positive for ETH, but it’s not an immediate “skyrocket” catalyst. ETH is around the $2.7K area, and if compiler improvements continue to be stable, they could provide a small support for price. But as long as Bitcoin continues to trade around $118.88K, Ethereum’s innovation momentum may be constrained. Only if a wave of blockbuster applications built with the new compiler emerges could that support potentially be activated. If the new compiler updates frequently and bugs become common, then this view is invalid.

新编译器不是小改动，是效率的革命。想想看，以前写个复杂合约得等半天编译，现在秒出结果。这背后是Ethereum生态长期发展的需求——智能合约越复杂，开发工具跟不上就会拖后腿。这像极了当年浏览器从IE6到Chrome的过程，能跑更复杂网页游戏的根本原因。现在Ethereum的智能合约应用（DeFi、NFT、GameFi）越来越重，编译器速度就是生产力。

对市场的影响
短期内对ETH的情绪可能有提振作用，毕竟开发体验改善了。但要说能直接拉到$3K，这个判断作废。长期看，更好的开发工具能让以太坊吸引更多开发者，理论上利好链上活动。但更关键的是，这会不会让其他链（比如Solana、Avalanche）用Solidity的生态也跟着受益？如果出现跨链开发工具的标准化竞争，那ETH的优势就减弱了。历史上看，技术迭代初期谁先跑出来谁占优（比如Web3.0早期以太坊的独占优势），但这次Solana的编译器速度也很快，形成双雄争霸。

操作思路
这个新闻对ETH是中性偏利好，但绝对不是暴涨催化剂。ETH在$2.7K附近，如果编译器能持续稳定，对价格是个小支撑。但只要比特币继续围绕$118.88K波动，以太坊的创新驱动力就会受限。如果出现大规模开发者用新编译器写出的爆款应用，这个支撑才可能被激活。如果新编译器更新频繁导致bug频发，这个判断作废。
